subject: Alignment: short-term BYOK variant & audit-log handling for MedTech POC
messages:
From: Claire Summers <csummers@medtech.example.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: poc@medtech.example.com
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BYOK + 7yr audit log retention for POC (May start)

Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo. To move our pilot forward we need two things confirmed for compliance:
- BYOK for data-at-rest in the POC environment (we understand long-term BYOK means HSM-managed keys, but for the pilot compliance wants customer control or escrow).
- Audit logs retained for 7 years, with per-request granularity (who, what, model-version, token counts).

Can you confirm if Redwood can support a short-term variant for the POC (May 1 start) while we evaluate a full BYOK integration? Also need SCIM/SSO provisioning (we've attached the SSO_SCIM_req.pdf).

Claire
Claire Summers
Dir., Security & Compliance
MedTech Solutions

Attachments: SSO_SCIM_req.pdf (pdf)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: poc@medtech.example.com
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK + 7yr audit log retention for POC (May start)

Team — forwarding Claire's request from MedTech. This is time-sensitive: POC target May 1. High-level asks: BYOK (customer-controlled key variant acceptable for pilot), 7yr audit retention with request-level detail, SCIM/SSO provisioning.

Options I see for a near-term POC:
1) BYOK-lite (recommended for POC): customer uploads an encryption key via a secured upload; Redwood holds key in a restricted escrow HSM with limited access controls and an audit trail. Not full customer HSM control, but satisfies pilot auditors with documented controls.
2) Envelope keys + monthly export: use Redwood-managed KMS to generate per-tenant envelope keys, and provide monthly encrypted exports of raw audit logs to customer storage.
3) Block & escalate: decline hosted BYOK for pilot and force private deployment (slower).

Questions for product/infra:
- Grace: feasibility/effort for BYOK-lite and escrow workflow (timeline + risk).
- Marcus: runtime implications and how we surface token-level fields in logs without PII leakage.
- Neha: what evidence artifacts the auditors will accept for BYOK-lite vs full BYOK.
- Lauren: customer messaging and contract language for the pilot exception (SLA/limits).

Can we aim to pick an approach and get an internal sign-off by EOD tomorrow? If so I'll respond to Claire with a plan and timeline.

Thanks — Jonas
VP, Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced by external: SSO_SCIM_req.pdf

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK + 7yr audit log retention for POC (May start)

Quick feasibility notes from infra:
- BYOK-lite is doable for a POC: implement an "escrow key" flow where customer provides a PEM key that we store in an HSM-backed keyvault with restricted ops (unseal only for crypto ops). We must:
  * Add key upload API + attestation flow (2–3 working days dev for POC path).
  * Add access controls and an audit trail (audit events stored separately and immutable; 2–4 days ops work).
- Full BYOK (customer-managed external HSM) requires network changes and dedicated tenancy — not possible for 2-week turnaround.

Audit logs: we can capture per-request metadata (timestamp, model-id, model-version, user-id, token-counts, route) and persist to an encrypted S3 bucket with lifecycle policy (7yr retention). Need product guidance on fields to include; privacy team will scrub PII.

Risks:
- BYOK-lite is an exception. Legal must sign off on key escrow terms.
- Long retention increases storage cost; need pricing/commitment from customer.

I'll prototype the upload + vault skeleton starting Mon. ETA for POC-ready flow: 10 business days if we prioritize. I'll add a short design doc (BYOK-lite-design.md) to the Confluence link.

—Grace
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BYOK-lite-design.md (draft)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Claire Summers <csummers@medtech.example.com>, poc@medtech.example.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BYOK + 7yr audit log retention for POC (May start) — redwood proposal

Claire — thanks for the detailed ask and for the quick turnaround. Internal triage yielded a POC-friendly approach we can deliver quickly while we evaluate a full BYOK integration. Proposed plan: 

1) BYOK-lite (POC variant) — what we will deliver by May 12:
   - Secure key upload: MedTech will provide a PEM key via secure upload. Redwood will store the key in an HSM-backed vault with restricted usage (cryptographic operations only).
   - Access controls & attestation: role-based controls and an immutable audit trail around key usage.
   - Governance: Legal will sign a POC key-escrow addendum (we will share draft).

2) Audit logs retention — what we will deliver by May 12:
   - Capture request-level fields: timestamp, user-id (pseudonymized), model-id, model-version, route, token counts, decisioning flags.
   - Persist logs to an encrypted S3 bucket with 7-year lifecycle and write-once log files. Monthly encrypted export available on request. See sample spec: AuditSpec_v1.xlsx (attached).

3) SSO/SCIM: we can enable basic SAML SSO quickly; full SCIM provisioning will be a follow-up (targeted for post-POC).

Action items & owners:
- Grace: BYOK-lite implementation + BYOK-lite-design.md (ETA May 12).
- Marcus: Log schema & runtime instrumentation; deliver AuditSpec_v1.xlsx.
- Neha: Compliance evidence package + draft addendum for key-escrow (I'll introduce legal).
- Lauren: Customer-facing pilot terms and pricing note for extra storage.

If this matches MedTech's minimal requirements for the POC, we'll share the key-escrow addendum and the secure upload URL by Monday. Please confirm if MedTech approves this approach or prefers to require an air-gapped/private deployment instead.

Best,
Jonas
VP, Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
